title: The Best FSD System In China! 1 Hour Drive Using Huawei Qiankun ADS 3.2 Installed In Avatr 11
summary: Out of Spec Reviews takes a one-hour drive in an Avatr 11 running Huawei's Qiankun ADS 3.2 driver assistance system in China, billed as the best FSD-like system there.
why: HN cites it as a real-world look at Huawei's lidar-based driver assistance when comparing against Tesla FSD.

quote.text: Here's the Out of Spec guys riding around on it in China for an hour
